name: Welcome
subject: Welcome to Kettlewick
preheader: Your code for 15% off the first bag, and what to expect from us.
summary: Sent once, straight after someone joins the list.

footer.reason: You are getting this email because you joined the Kettlewick list on our website.

hero.alt: A cup of coffee on its saucer seen from above, next to a bag of Kettlewick beans

intro: Thanks for joining. We are a two-person roastery on Wharf Lane in Port Ellery, and we roast every Tuesday.
That means the coffee you order this week was still green a few days before it reaches your door.

code.label: Your welcome code
code.terms: 15% off your first bag of coffee, until 30 November.

steps.title: One email a month
steps.text: Roast notes arrives on the first Friday with new coffees and one brew tip. Nothing in between unless you order.

steps.title: Roasted Tuesday, posted Wednesday
steps.text: Order by Monday night and your bag leaves the roastery the morning after it was roasted.

steps.title: Help from a person
steps.text: Reply to any email and Mara or Theo will answer, usually the same day.
